title: alchemilla cavillieri
intro: Alchemilla cavillieri, commonly known as Lady's Mantle, is a perennial flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including the ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce menstrual cramps, and exhibit anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla cavillieri are attributed to its astringent, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
